source.name: California Department of Fish and Wildlife - 2025 Big Game Drawing statistics (2026 California Big Game Digest tables and 2025 Tag Drawing Statistics PDFs)

notes: CDFW 2025 Big Game Drawing (draw held June 2025). California uses a MODIFIED PREFERENCE POINT system for every species (deer, elk, pronghorn, bighorn sheep): each hunt's quota is split into a preference-point portion (highest points first, ties by random number) and a random 'draw-by-choice' portion. Splits: premium deer 90/10; apprentice deer 50/50; elk, pronghorn and bighorn sheep quota 1 = random only, 2 = 1+1, 3 = 2+1, 4+ = 75% preference. Party applications use the party's AVERAGE points, so point values can be fractional (e.g. 8.6667). There is NO bonus-point system in California. RESIDENCY: CDFW publishes no residency split; residents and nonresidents apply in the same pool. DEER rows put the combined figures in BOTH draw.resident and draw.nonresident (identical; nonresidents compete equally for deer). ELK, PRONGHORN and BIGHORN SHEEP rows put the combined figures in draw.resident and leave draw.nonresident null, because regulation caps nonresidents (only ONE nonresident may be drawn for elk and one for pronghorn statewide per year; nonresidents get at most 10% of bighorn tags), so the combined odds do not apply to a nonresident. SOURCES: DEER draw numbers = '2025 Deer Tag Drawing Statistics' tables in the 2026 California Big Game Digest (pp.29-31, https://nrm.dfg.ca.gov/FileHandler.ashx?DocumentID=200602&inline), which print per hunt: tag quota, preference / random quotas, total 1st-choice applicants, max-point (23) applicants, tags awarded in the preference drawing, highest and LOWEST point value awarded in the preference drawing, and random-drawing tags awarded to 1st / 2nd / 3rd-choice applicants. ELK / PRONGHORN / SHEEP draw numbers = the 2026 Digest hunt tables (elk pp.48-52, pronghorn pp.58-59, bighorn p.61), which print 2025 tag quota, preference / random quotas, total applicants and max-point applicants. Hunt names = CDFW '2025 ... Tag Drawing Statistics - Number of Applicants by Point Value' PDFs (https://wildlife.ca.gov/Licensing/Statistics/Big-Game-Drawing; deer https://nrm.dfg.ca.gov/FileHandler.ashx?DocumentID=242657/242658/242661/242665/242669, elk https://nrm.dfg.ca.gov/FileHandler.ashx?DocumentID=242638/242639/242643, pronghorn https://nrm.dfg.ca.gov/FileHandler.ashx?DocumentID=242634/242635, bighorn https://nrm.dfg.ca.gov/FileHandler.ashx?DocumentID=242632); every row's quota, preference quota, random quota and applicant count was matched against those PDFs. HOW FIELDS WERE DERIVED. DEER: tags = tag quota; applicants = total 1st-choice applicants; successPct = (tags awarded in the preference drawing + random-drawing tags awarded to 1st-choice applicants) / 1st-choice applicants x 100 (computed here, not a CDFW figure; capped at 100); minPoints = CDFW's printed 'Lowest Point Value Awarded Tag in Preference Drawing' (0 where every 1st-choice applicant drew). pools: preference = tags awarded in the preference drawing / all 1st-choice applicants; random = 1st-choice random awards / 1st-choice applicants left after the preference round. Tags that went to 2nd/3rd-choice applicants are noted in the label. ELK / PRONGHORN / SHEEP: one hunt choice per application, so successPct = min(quota, applicants) / applicants x 100 (computed here; assumes the full 2025 quota was issued in the draw, which CDFW does not print); minPoints = null (CDFW does not publish the lowest point value drawn for these species); pool applicant counts are not published. pointLines are NOT filled: CDFW publishes applicants by point value but not how many drew at each point value. Hunts new for 2026 (no 2025 quota, shown as '-' in the Digest) are omitted. Preference-point-only codes (PD, 499, 799, 599) are omitted. UNITS: deer zone hunts use the zone name as spelled in CDFW BIOS layer ds342 field Zone_Nam (e.g. 'X3a'); the C-zone hunt (C) covers C1-C4; area-specific archery (A), general late-season (G), apprentice (J) and muzzleloader (M, MA) hunts use the hunt code, which is the 'Zone' field of BIOS layers ds3242 / ds3241. Elk unit = elk hunt area NAME in BIOS ds786 (hunt 422 Owens Valley Multiple Zone covers Bishop, Independence, Goodale, Lone Pine). Pronghorn unit = zone number (BIOS ds787 'Zone'); bighorn unit = zone number (BIOS ds784 'Zone_Num'). WEAPON: 'General Season'/'General Methods' = rifle (any legal method); zone tags valid for 'Archery and General Seasons' (D12, D14, D17) = any; MA hunts and elk 303 are muzzleloader OR archery and are tagged muzzleloader. No season dates: the 2026 Digest prints 2026 dates, not 2025.
